declared_criteria.D1: the question pool is made of real executed runs and both real goals have positive and negative runs
declared_criteria.D2: the moved goal has no positive-term conjunction of two literals but does have a literal conjunction
declared_criteria.D3: both goals are identified from user bits on real runs within ceil(log2(class)) questions
declared_criteria.D4: both identified sentences agree with every verdict on 128 deeper runs never used in the pool
declared_criteria.D5: a goal outside the class fails closed with a named cause and no chosen sentence
declared_criteria.D6: zero model calls, zero stored parameters, zero network calls at run time

prototype_note: a scratch probe over the same pool was run while writing the tool to check that the moved goal needed negation; the criteria above are structural and were fixed before this receipt run

limits: the pool and the held-out runs are the same real tool at different depths; a different tool is not tested here
conjunctions of at most two literals are a stated class; a goal outside it refuses
the scripted user's bits come from the project's own judges, not from a model
no edit, no GUI, no SWE-bench or OSWorld task is attempted
